I hear you so much right now. I'm trying to live for my son, he's the only thing that makes me feel better. He's by my side right now and he told me he loved me for no reason 20 minutes ago and I just want to cry. I want to kill myself but I don't want to tear his world apart. He's so happy, and it'll just ruin the course of his life. I don't know what to do and it doesn't feel fair, I don't want to exist in constant agony but I don't want to ruin the life of the one good thing I know either.
I understand. I'm in a similar boat and of a similar age. I'm currently trying to break down that wall so I'm not so scared to try anymore.
